sentence: This project builds a tiny chip that counts single molecules in a sample without needing bulky instruments.
This project tests a computer method that detects reward-related behaviors during Pavlovian conditioning to better understand addiction.
This project studies how a change to an enzyme in liver macrophages affects alcohol-associated liver disease.
This project builds a low-cost urine test that uses flow cytometry to detect bladder cancer early.
This project uses a mouse model to study how stem cells balance self-renewal and differentiation.
This project uses computer modelling and lab assays to find how mutations stop a drug from working against chronic myeloid leukemia.
This project provides computing resources and expert help for analyzing genetic data sets.
This project studies how protein quality control affects DNA damage responses in Huntington's disease.
This project studies how a cancer vaccine and other drugs that work on the immune system act in a rare cancer.
This project studies single cells in tumors to find weak points that drugs could target.
This project studies how changes to histones control genes that help mosquitoes survive winter dormancy.
This project builds a web portal that lets researchers analyze circular RNAs on a computer without needing computer expertise.
This project provides computing help, a human biospecimen biobank and statistics help for digestive disease researchers.
This project builds methods that use whole-genome sequencing data to predict a person's risk of inherited diseases more accurately.
This project studies how immune receptors called Toll-like receptors wrongly respond to self nucleic acids and cause autoimmune disease.
This project studies what causes retinal ganglion cells to degenerate in two inherited optic neuropathies.
This project tests an oncolytic virus combined with a checkpoint inhibitor in dogs with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
This project studies how far Aedes aegypti mosquitoes spread and which genes change in different environments.
This project studies how the amount of one gene controls how synapses develop in three dimensional cortical organoids.
This project develops chemical probes to study how peptide messengers between cells work in disease.
